title: Run a bounded improvement experiment
summary: Compare changes against a fixed objective while retaining requirements that the measured score may miss.

sections.label: Use this workflow
sections.text: Use when a small repeatable experiment can resolve a decision or improve a candidate. Ordinary deterministic changes are valid. An autonomous agent is optional.

sections.label: Inputs
items: Candidate and baseline revisions, a specific objective and representative cases.
Independent acceptance checks, retained requirements and held-out material where useful.
Actual commands, environment, time/cost budget and a stop rule.

sections.label: Repository contributions
sections.text: Karpathy autoresearch documents a single-GPU model-training loop in which an agent changes training code, runs a fixed-budget experiment and evaluates the result. Atlas adapts the experiment method to other tasks without claiming that this package performs general internet research.

sections.label: Procedure
items: Freeze the objective, cases, evaluator and baseline before comparing candidates.
Name behavior, content and review requirements that the objective does not measure.
Propose one scoped change and record its revision.
Run the configured experiment only when the needed environment and authority are available.
Compare observed results under equivalent conditions. Detect stale caches, invalid runs and leakage from development cases.
Inspect retained changes against all acceptance requirements and relevant held-out cases. A higher score alone is insufficient.
Keep, discard or revise with recorded reasons. Stop at the budget or unresolved evidence, then hand off the observations.

sections.label: Outputs
sections.text: A reproducible comparison record, candidate revisions, accepted changes and unresolved tradeoffs.

sections.label: Acceptance checks
items: The evaluator and important requirements did not silently change between candidates.
Invalid, cached or unrun results are not wins.
Required features, review steps and failure behavior remain intact.
Reported gains remain scoped to the tested cases and environment.

sections.label: Illustrative example
sections.text: Compare two extraction prompts on reviewed documents while retaining citation accuracy and required fields as separate checks. A better aggregate score cannot accept a missing field. No prompt, training run or experiment has been executed in this example.

basis: Inspected repository documentation and recommended Atlas procedure. Examples are illustrative.
confidence: Moderate for the scoped source contributions. Project fit and workflow outcomes remain unverified.

catalog.applicability: Compare changes against a fixed objective while retaining requirements that the measured score may miss.
catalog.limits: Reading guidance does not install a repository, select a tool, execute a workflow or establish a passing result. Use actual project versions, commands and evidence.

claims.text: The autoresearch reference implements a fixed-budget single-GPU model-training experiment loop.
